answer.reason: The person's story is told in Jacob's adoption and blessing of him in Genesis 48, while the many other verses concern his tribe, not him.

clauses.english: was taken by Jacob as his own son, like Reuben and Simeon
clauses.quote: are mine; as Reuben and Simeon, they shall be mine

clauses.english: was blessed by Jacob, who set his younger brother Ephraim before him
clauses.quote: and he set Ephraim before Manasseh

doubts: Verses on the tribe of Manasseh (census, lot, cities, Reubenites and Gadites, exile) concern the tribe, not the person, and were left out.
The birth and naming verses (GEN 41:50-51, GEN 46:20) were left out as minor beside the blessing.
